newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore prepares Cambodia evacuation - TV.
newsitem.headline: Singapore prepares Cambodia evacuation - TV.

text.p: Singapore's embassy in Phnom Penh is trying to evacuate its nationals from strife-torn Cambodia, state television said on Tuesday.
Quoting a source in Cambodia, the Television Corp of Singapore said the embassy was handling the logistics involved in tracking about 280 Singaporeans trapped in the country.
It said 100 Singaporeans had gathered at the Sofitel Cambodiana Hotel in the capital, scene of heavy weekend fighting between forces loyal to the country's rival co-premiers.
A Singapore Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) spokesman had no immediate comment on the report.
Thailand on Tuesday evacuated several hundred people from Phnom Penh using military transport planes.
Scheduled flights from Phnom Penh's international airport were cancelled on Saturday because of the fighting.
